results.title: Cricket-Renshaw, Green guide Australia to 191-4
results.description: CAPE TOWN, Oct 28 (Reuters) - Matt Renshaw (74) and Cameron Green (65) scored half centuries but were dismissed just before tea as Australia went to the interval on 191 for four on the second day of the decisive third test against South Africa at Newlands on Wednesday.

results.title: Digimon Card Game Launches Digital Mobile Experience with New Story Mode
results.description: Bandai's Digimon Alysion mobile adaptation of the popular trading card game is now open for pre‑registration, set to release on December 23 across 49 regions worldwide. The digital transformation expands the core card mechanics, introduces exclusive new cards, and offers a narrative-driven Story Mode that guides newcomers through the game's rules while featuring voice‑acted characters and brand‑new lore. Pre‑registration is already drawing huge interest among fans eager to experience Digimon battles on their phones.

results.title: Ultims in the Route du Rhum: Land of the giants
results.description: It's a full house! All of the world's eight giant 32 metre long Ultim-class trimarans will gather on the same starting line Sunday off Saint Malor for the classic ocean sprint, the Route du Rhum Destination Guadeloupe.
